title: CMD: choose what a container runs
summary: One image, two programs. Run say.js instead of the web app, change the default, then switch back from the command line.

tasks.title: A container `say-ravi`, from `greet-cmd`, ran `say.js` and printed `Hello, Ravi!`
tasks.hint: Words after the image name replace its `CMD`: `docker run --name say-ravi -e NAME=Ravi greet-cmd node say.js`. It prints one line and stops; `docker logs say-ravi` shows it again.

tasks.title: The image `sayer` runs `say.js` when you give it no command
tasks.hint: Change the last line of the `Dockerfile` to `CMD ["node", "say.js"]`, save, then `docker build -t sayer .` Try it: `docker run --rm sayer`.

tasks.title: `sayer-web`, from `sayer`, serves the web page on `http://localhost:3404`
tasks.hint: Now go the other way: replace `sayer`'s `CMD` from the command line. `docker run -d --name sayer-web -p 3404:3000 sayer node app.js`.
